implemented_on_integration: 47 public source definitions; 45 scheduled (43 hourly, two weekly).
Read-only public ingestion adapter with strict host allowlist, response-size limits and timestamp freshness gates.
RawReceiptArchive with SHA-256 source bytes, canonical receipts and a per-run local hash chain.
Point-in-time SQLite feature store with append-only application triggers.
Naive, momentum, mean-reversion and volatility baselines.
Chronological walk-forward evaluation with purge/embargo and overlapping-horizon effective-sample controls.
Temporal calibration diagnostics and PSI drift checks.
Fail-closed forecast ledger requiring independent Ed25519 evaluator attestation.

readiness_gate.requirement: A non-baseline model must beat all four baselines on both Brier score and log loss, with trusted evaluator attestation.

outstanding: No external WORM anchor or trusted timestamp service.
No replayable synchronized historical spot/L2/derivatives/flow/collateral feature archive.
SQLite append-only triggers are not tamper-proof storage.
No production evaluator signing key is configured.
No independent shadow outcomes or measured model lift.
No non-baseline predictive model has passed the readiness gate; current implementation is evaluation infrastructure plus baselines.
PSI is univariate feature drift, not full multivariate or concept-drift monitoring.
Event and scenario outputs are deterministic hypotheses, not causal estimates.
